title: RBI Exempts Fresh 3-5 Year FCNR(B) Deposits from CRR and SLR Maintenance
summary: Temporarily removes reserve requirements on fresh FCNR(B) deposits to boost dollar inflows till Sept 30, 2026.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Exempts Fresh 3-5 Year FCNR(B) Deposits from CRR and SLR Maintenance. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Temporarily removes reserve requirements on fresh FCNR(B) deposits to boost dollar inflows till Sept 30, 2026.
Reserve Exemption: Fresh FCNR(B) deposits (tenor 3 to 5 years) mobilized between June 8 and Sept 30, 2026 exempted from CRR and SLR.
USD-INR Forex Swap: Introduced US Dollar-Rupee Forex Swap facility for PSU ECBs and bank OFCBs (min 3-yr tenor, up to 5 yrs) at 1.5% p.a.
FCNR(B) reserve exemption deposit tenor (3 to 5 years) vs swap facility rate (1.5% p.a.).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
